profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Braze
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of building automation infrastructure and testing frameworks. Skilled in Python, Bash, and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed a service in Python using Docker to monitor all changes to objects within AWS S3; service utilizes Cassandra as the backend database and consumes 1.2 million messages per day while alerting on changes that pose security risks.
• Installed third party security tools on GrubHub systems; developed monitoring infrastructure using Python while leveraging Datadog and Splunk to ensure universal deployment and maximum uptime.
• Developed AWS Lambda functions using Python to monitor security compliance standards on AWS S3 and EC2 resources, and implemented deployment automation and monitoring for AWS Lambdas.
• Built automation that utilized Puppet to build and deploy base linux images used in AWS throughout GrubHub, ensuring consistency across the platform for security packages and upgrades.

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained several in-house testing suites using Python and Rust; established testing protocols for performance and stability, restructured testing efforts, and increased test coverage by 60%.
• Established a monitoring system for client sites using Docker and Python; collected various data points critical to site performance. Optimizations based off data collected increased site throughput by 20%.
• Designed and developed core infrastructure used by the deployment and development teams to upgrade and recover Starry hardware in the field.
• Developed a REST API in Python that automates the running of test suites and various diagnostic tools remotely.
• Integrated TestRail and Jenkins into the test process to significantly reduce manual testing and increase the visibility of automation efforts and test results.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Primary builder for zOS elements JES2, JES3, and LE - built, installed, and tested code updates for each element.
• Established and maintained improved methods of service and upkeep for Software Validation, Integrated Service, and Software System test environments.
• Reduced manual installation and upkeep significantly through Rexx and JCL based automation.
• Developed a Java application used to query the status of and apply packages to various mainframes used within the zSHIP team.

positions.title: Academic and Research Computing Help Desk Consultant
positions.description: Provided technical support to the student body and faculty for various software used in classes and research, in addition to performing miscellaneous IT tasks.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Developed methods for collecting and storing metamorphic data from various scientific papers using Java.
• Maintained group webpage and server. Ensured database was updated with current results.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote and debugged unit tests in C# for UI and method automation using Visual Studio.
• Designed and developed several utilities used by the quality assurance and development teams.
